scripts.setup: rm -rf dist && bun run --cwd ../../packages build && fics-routing --entries
scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' EXIT INT TERM; bun run setup && { fics-routing --entries --watch & bun run bundle --watch --no-clear-screen & bun run --hot app.ts; }
scripts.build: bun run setup && bun run bundle --production && bun scripts/prerender.ts
